Yes — that preview is exactly how I'd want my old pile handled, and honestly it's more thoughtful than I expected. It shows me *before* anything happens what it found: how many are new, how many I already have, and which ones it can't make sense of — so there are no surprises and I can look before I leap. My browser's folders turning into labels is perfect, since that's already how I'd loosely organized things, and it even keeps the nesting by giving a link each folder's name. Keeping the original dates I first saved them matters to me too — I don't want my whole history suddenly stamped as "today" — and it's honest that the odd one without a date will just use today.

And crucially, it promises not to trample anything I already have: a page that's already in my library won't get duplicated, and my own title, labels, and note on it stay put. That's the "keep my words" rule we agreed, applied to importing. So yes — this is precisely how I'd want to bring my messy browser pile in. Let me see it actually bring them in, then we'll check export.
